class.name: AudioEffectSteamReflectionSend
class.brief_description: Passes dry audio onward while submitting Steam Audio reflections to an Ambisonic return effect.
class.description: This effect belongs before [AudioEffectSteamDirect] and [AudioEffectSteamSpatial]. Its Godot stereo output is an unchanged copy of its input. In parallel, it folds the input to mono, applies Steam Audio's parametric reflection effect, packages the diffuse result as a first-order omnidirectional Ambisonic block, and submits that block to [member target]. The target is the stable [AudioEffectSteamReflectionHRTF] resource, not its transient [AudioEffectInstance]. Consequently, Godot may rebuild effect instances when the bus layout or channel configuration changes without breaking the relationship. The target resource directly owns four dynamically sized channel arrays and copy-adds submissions into them. This initial implementation exposes manual RT60 values and does not inspect scene geometry. A future convolution producer can submit directional Ambisonic reflection data through the same target interface.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], generates and submits reflected audio. The dry signal remains unchanged regardless of this value.
Low-, mid-, and high-frequency RT60 decay times in seconds. Components are clamped to [code]0.1[/code]–[code]20.0[/code].
Nonnegative linear gain applied to the reflected signal before submission.
Receiver resource that accumulates and HRTF-decodes submitted Ambisonic blocks. Multiple sends may target the same receiver.
